braid_multiplication_order.value: juxtaposition: the word X Y is the braid X followed by the braid Y; words are read LEFT TO RIGHT
braid_multiplication_order.source: src-tg-birman-brendle-2005 Sec.1 (Fig.1: 'their product XY'; 'Multiplication of braids is by juxtaposition')

sigma_i_orientation.value: sigma_i is the elementary braid of BB Fig.2(i) exchanging strands i and i+1; its orientation is FIXED relative to the free-group action by eq.(20): sigma_i x_i sigma_i^{-1} = x_{i+1}

free_group_generators_x_i.value: F_n = pi_1(D_n, d_0), D_n the n-punctured disk with punctures q_1..q_n; x_i is the loop based at d_0 on the boundary travelling COUNTERCLOCKWISE about q_i

left_vs_right_action.value: LEFT action alpha: B_n -> Aut(F_n), alpha(beta)(x) = beta x beta^{-1} in F_n x| B_n; alpha(XY) = alpha(X) o alpha(Y), so for a word the RIGHTMOST letter acts first
left_vs_right_action.source: src-tg-birman-brendle-2005 Sec.4.7 eq.(19),(20); left-action law verified in certificate S2 (left_action_verified_on_probe)

function_composition_order.value: (f o g)(x) = f(g(x)); Endo.compose(self, other) = self o other, other applied first

hurwitz_action_convention.value: LEFT action on Hom(F_n, G): (beta . rho) = rho o alpha(beta^{-1}). Closed form for sigma_i: (M_i, M_{i+1}) -> (M_i M_{i+1} M_i^{-1}, M_i). The variant rho o alpha(beta) is a RIGHT action with closed form (M_i, M_{i+1}) -> (M_{i+1}, M_{i+1}^{-1} M_i M_{i+1}); it is recorded and is NOT the frozen convention
hurwitz_action_convention.source: DERIVED from the frozen Artin action; certificate HURWITZ (closed_form checks); no separate literature source is claimed

puncture_ordering.value: punctures q_1..q_n of D_n numbered so that sigma_i exchanges q_i and q_{i+1}; target roots r_1..r_n of f_{a,E} carry the same numbering (any reordering is an element of S_n and is recorded, not assumed)

B_n_to_S_n_quotient_convention.value: pi_perm(sigma_i) = s_i = (i i+1); permutations are tuples p with p[k] = image of k and are composed LEFT TO RIGHT, (p*q)(k) = q(p(k)), so pi_perm is a homomorphism from the juxtaposition product
B_n_to_S_n_quotient_convention.source: src-tg-birman-brendle-2005 Sec.1.1 eq.(1), Sec.4.1; certificate S1

reduced_vs_unreduced_burau.value: UNREDUCED: sigma_i -> I_{i-1} (+) [[1-t, t],[1, 0]] (+) I_{n-i-1} in GL_n. REDUCED: sigma_i -> I_{i-2} (+) [[1,-t,0],[0,-t,0],[0,-1,1]] (+) I_{n-i-2} in GL_{n-1}, the -t in the (i,i) spot. The two are never interchanged; dimensions n and n-1
reduced_vs_unreduced_burau.source: src-tg-birman-brendle-2005 Sec.4.2 p.46 (signs read from the rendered PDF page, not from a text extraction)

burau_specialization_value.value: t = -1 (the specialization used by 00A check S1 and by BMP's beta_n); t = 2 is a CONTROL specialization only; t = 1 recovers the permutation representation
burau_specialization_value.source: src-hmc-brendle-margalit-putman-2015 Sec.1 (Burau at t = -1); src-tg-birman-brendle-2005 Sec.4.2 (t = 1)

matrices_acting_on_rows_vs_columns.value: matrices act on COLUMN vectors from the LEFT; beta(XY) = beta(X) beta(Y). The row-vector (right) action on the sum-zero hyperplane is used only as a decomposition control and is transposed before comparison

conjugation_convention.value: conj(a, b) = a b a^{-1}; the Artin action is conjugation of x_j by sigma_i in F_n x| B_n, sigma_i x_j sigma_i^{-1}

word_equality.value: two braid words are compared only through their images (in S_n, Aut(F_n), or GL); two free-group words are equal iff their free reductions coincide

B_n.definition: pi_1(C_{0,n}, base) of the unordered configuration space of n points in C (BB Sec.1.1); source-side parameter loops

F_n.definition: pi_1(P^1_q minus (n finite roots of f_{a,E} + infinity)) = pi_1(D_n, d_0), free on x_1..x_n

S_n.definition: symmetric group on the n strands / punctures

G_diff.definition: differential Galois group of the algebraic NVE over C(q); contains the Zariski closure of the image of rho_tgt (Fuchsian case, source IDENTIFIED only in 00A)

permanent: REPRESENTATION != ITS_DUAL (for even n the reduced Burau at t=-1 and its dual are inequivalent; only the dual carries an invariant alternating form)
